sources.quote: Fully accessible toilets are located on every floor on the concourses.

alt_accessible_entrance.note: South Entrance of the Blavatnik Building, with RADAR-key lifts down to the Turbine Hall

sources.quote: Once you have parked, enter via the South Entrance of the Blavatnik Building across the level terrace, approximately 30 - 60 metres from the parking spaces.
Two RADAR Key operated lifts link the South Entrance on Level 1 and the Ticket desks in the Turbine Hall.
We welcome guide dogs, hearing dogs and assistance dogs in the gallery.

changing_places.note: Level 0, Natalie Bell Building; RADAR key

sources.quote: A Changing Places toilet is available on Level 0 of the Natalie Bell Building.
The ticket desks are fitted with a hearing loop.

lift.note: In both buildings, on every floor

sources.quote: There are four lifts in the Natalie Bell Building, by the main stairs on each floor.
There are eight lifts in the Blavatnik Building, situated by the main stairs on each floor
